shots.p: wide shot of a desert encampment at al-Hudaybiyah with tents near Mecca, a peace treaty being signed under a tree, hopeful dawn
a bright clear sunrise over the Hijaz mountains, a straight road to the horizon, a sense of forgiveness and victory
a triumphant but humble caravan marching across a desert at sunrise, banners lifted, mighty support
close-up of calm believers' faces in a desert camp, tranquility settling in their hearts, golden light
believing men and women walking into a lush garden with rivers under palaces, joyful and forgiven
hypocrites whispering suspiciously in a dark tent with evil assumptions, a storm cloud overhead
dramatic sky with immense rolling clouds and lightning over vast mountains, hosts of the heavens and earth
a lone lighthouse shining over the sea at dawn, carrying good news and warning to ships
believers at dawn prayer and remembrance in the morning and evening light, reverent
men placing their hands one over another in a pledge beneath a tree, solemn faces, desert background
Bedouin men making excuses at their tents, pointing to their herds and families, insincere faces
Bedouins sitting by their tents assuming the caravan will never return, smug, while the horizon brightens
a scorching desert plain blazing under a fierce sun, a stark warning
vast sky over the earth, sunlight and rain falling in different areas, mercy and justice
men who stayed behind running to join a caravan heading to the rich oasis of Khaybar, greedy expressions
Bedouin men being summoned to arms before a formidable army in the distance, tense faces
a blind elderly man and a man with a crutch sitting peacefully at home, excused and at ease
believers pledging allegiance under a large acacia tree in the desert, tranquility on their faces
wide shot of abundant spoils of grain, date palms and fortified orchards at Khaybar oasis
believers returning safely to their families with blessings, hands of enemies held back
distant fortified cities on hills, gifts yet to come, golden sunset light
an enemy army turning back and retreating across the desert, no battle
ancient unchanging stars wheeling over the desert, an eternal law
two groups at the outskirts of Mecca holding back from fighting, peace prevailing in the valley
sacrificial camels tethered in the desert prevented from reaching the sanctuary, believers hidden among the townspeople
proud men refusing to sign a treaty with arrogant faces, while believers remain calm and composed
pilgrims in white ihram garments entering the sacred mosque peacefully, some with shaved heads, safety and joy
sunrise rising above all horizons, light spreading over the whole world
rows of believers bowing and prostrating in prayer, faces humble; then a green field of wheat sprouting strong stalks
